Front-End Web Development

Jentezen Franklin Media Ministries

Project Overview

Maintain and develop the Jentezen Franklin Media Ministries website using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Ruby on Rails in collaboration with additonal in-house and contract developers. Create interface designs in Figma before implementation, apply responsive design, perform cross-browser testing and routine site audits, and coordinate site direction and technical updates with project stakeholders.

Led the October 2023 website redesign and rebrand, refining the visitor experience across desktop, tablet, and mobile. Introduced rounded corners and transitioned the site typography to San Francisco Pro.

Assisted in designing and implementing key front-end updates to the 2026 redesign. Built custom outreach, campaign, promotion, and donation landing pages in Ruby on Rails, and refined layouts across desktop, tablet, and mobile through cross-browser testing in Chrome and Safari.

This project is currently in development.

Explore the pre-redesign site on the Wayback Machine.
